title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash 91bc4b83f3a0… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash 91bc4b83f3a02601f6038c1aa99af51f13b5742fb7f933003bbe27e61e1a80f8 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. This file is associated with attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) and was seen originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file likely represents a malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool. Organizations are advised to check for this hash in their environments and security tools.
